conditions.name: Foresight
conditions.label: Weak Buff
conditions.body: When you have Foresight, you can spend 1 stack of Foresight to reroll an Attack or Damage roll. At the end of your turn lose 2 stacks of Foresight. Minor Dispells remove 2 stacks of Foresight.

conditions.name: Burn
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Burn is a stackable Weak Debuff that deals **1d6** Fire damage per stack consumed. At the start of turn make a **CON** save and take the damage on fail. On fail remove up to **2 stacks** if able, or only 1 stack if the roll succeeded. The Save DC is **13** or the caster’s DC, whichever is higher. The caster also adds **[STAT]** to damage total damage rolls. Minor Dispells remove 3 stacks of Burn.

conditions.name: Bleed
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Bleed is a stackable Weak Debuff that deals damage whenever the bleeding creature performs an Action. When the they perform a *Full Action* or *Reaction* they take **1d6** Physical damage. When they perform a *Half* or *Extra Action*, they take **1d4** Physical damage instead. Any of those Actions removes 1 stack of bleed. The caster also adds **[STAT]** to damage total damage rolls. 1 stack of Bleed is removed per 3 Health healed.  3 stacks of Bleed are removed with a Minor Dispell. All stacks of Bleed are removed during a Long or Short Rest.

conditions.name: Chill
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Chill is a stackable Weak Debuff that decreases movement speed by half rounded down, as well as decreasing Attack Rolls and AC by -1 per stack. Chill stacks up to **6** times. 1 stack of Chill is removed at the end of turn, and for every 8 Fire damage taken. Any creature affected by Chill can use a Full Action to warm themselves up and remove 3 stacks of Chill. This action may be restricted in certain conditions (environment, spell effects, etc).

conditions.name: Freeze
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Freeze (or being Frozen) is a Weak Debuff that Immobilizes affected creature and prevents them from taking Actions. Freeze can last multiple turns and 1 turn is removed from the duration for every 16 Fire damage taken. Anyone can use a Full Action to make a [SAVE] and warm up a frozen creature to reduce the number of turns by -2. This action may be restricted in certain conditions (environment, spell effects, etc). Freezing an frozen target increases the duration based on the strength of the freeze applied.

conditions.name: Immobilize
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Immobilized creatures **cannot move** and fail any **AGI** rolls. You can still Teleport while immobilized. Immobilize is a Weak Debuff.

conditions.name: Disarm
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Disarmed creatures cannot make Attack actions, although they can still cast spells but do not gain the benefit of a spell Foci or items equipped in their hands. Disarm is a Weak Debuff.

conditions.name: Fear
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: A creature that is Feared against a enemy cannot willingly move towards the enemy while it has line of sight of the enemy, and it makes attack/spell attack rolls against the enemy with Disadvantage. Fear is a Weak Debuff.

conditions.name: Charm
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: A charmed creature treats its charmer as **friendly** and an ally, it cannot make attacks against them and any AoE abilities that don’t affect allies also don’t affect its charmer. If the charmer damages or negatively affects the creature, Charm ends completely. Charm can last multiple turns, and applying Charm to an already charmed creature increases the duration. Charm is a Weak Debuff.

conditions.name: Taunt
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: A taunted creature must make all attack rolls and target all spells towards the enemy who taunted them until the end of their turn. Taunt is a Weak Debuff.

conditions.name: Shock
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Shocked creatures lose a **Half Action** during their turn. Shock is a stackable *Weak Debuff* that loses *1 stack* at the end of turn.

conditions.name: Electrocute
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: Electrocuted creatures lose a **Full Action** during their turn.  Electrocution is a *Weak Debuff* that dispells at the end of turn.

conditions.name: Blind
conditions.label: Weak Debuff
conditions.body: A blinded creature makes Physical and Spell attack rolls with Disadvantage, has -2 to AC, and automatically fail AGI and DEX saves, or saves that directly require eyesight. Blind is a Weak Debuff and can last multiple turns.

conditions.name: Paranoia
conditions.label: Strong Debuff
conditions.body: A Paranoid creature does not act normally during their turn. They must use all **Actions** attacking or casting Spells against the closest creature, **including allies**. Paranoia is a *Strong Debuff*.

conditions.name: Paralysis
conditions.label: Strong Debuff
conditions.body: Paralyzed creatures cannot move, cannot use **Actions** to make **Martial** or **Spell Attacks**, cannot use **Reactions**, and automatically **fails AGI**, **STR** and **DEX** saves. Paralysis is a *Strong Debuff* that dispells at the end of turn.
